Hi all
Little bit about my situation. So I gave up smoking weed after 22 years 6 months ago. Only used it in the evenings to chill out after work.so on June 9th I had a weird anxiety attack out no where never had one before. Anyway I decided to give the weed up on the back of it. Even thou I was given the all clear that it was only an anxiety attack I was convinced it was a heart issue and decided to have scans blood tests etc which all come back fine. But I still feel like there is an issue as I don’t feel myself. I constantly check on google and chat gpt with a symptom which I’m trying to stop. I also have been struggling with sleep quite badly. Since June 9th I’m lucky if I sleep 4-5 hours a night. So I believe that that real lack of sleep since this started is causing my body to ach badly and the anxiety of thinking there is somthing wrong is also adding to all this. My main symptoms are dry throat feels like I have a lump in it when I swallow, aching body (wrists ankles fingers legs) and dizzy spells. I never ever worried about my health prior to all this. Any input from you guys would be much appreciated❤️need to try get to the bottom of this as it’s been a nightmare past 6 months
